Total BS. Scam!

reviews.text: May Mays Shop. Too many ads
Accuracy?. Consistently misidentifies birds that I already know.
Sales. This is Michigan. We don’t have robins in January . Every bird I take a photo of is a robin according to you. WTH? Not helpful at all.
Love the accuracy. Live the concept and the accuracy, just hate that I have to suffer through ads with every snap. Wish there was a paid version to eliminate ads and enjoy an enhanced experience
Wouldn’t work. This app might be good, if it actually worked. I never could get past Profile. It just gave me the option to sign in or delete the account.

reviews.text: Charlee. The best app in the world it’s free and you can identify birds and I personally love it and I think you should try it too
Ads. It’s ok so far but it has ADS
Intrusive ads. The ads are so intrusive and inappropriate

Horrible! Google picture works 100x better. Do not buy! I want a refund!. It guess my boyfriend as a blue Robin!! I tried to use it on several breeds of chicken and it was totally off or just said “chicken”. I wish I could post the screenshots here of my results!!
Carolina House Finch. You misidentified my photo as a Northern Cardinal when it’s actually a Carolina House Finch.
Information. It’s has a lot of interesting stuff
extraneous ads. The app keeps asking to install other apps to id plants etc which i don’t want and there is apparently no way to stop it!
Birds. I LOVE THIS APP🩷🩵💙💕💖💞💘💓💝💗
Helpful game (birds). This game is really helpful with birds.
App Problems. To many adds when you view birds.
Wrong birds!. Do not download consistently provides incorrect bird names even when provided perfect quality images. Your photos app will give you better results without this.
Scan a chicken. I scanned my chicken and it told me it was a canary this does not work it a waste of money don’t buy theses people don’t know anything about birds

Gallery Photo’s. I attempted to create an account to see my photo’s but to activate it you need to confirm in an email I’m supposed to receive. Checked my email several times including spam folder and nothing there. Can’t activate the account. Tried to recreate the account and message says my email already exists yet I can’t log in.

reviews.text: Wrong I’d. Identified a female cardinal as a mallard duck
Red Shouldered Hawk. I’m impressed with this bird identification tool, quick I’d, plus considerable information given about each bird species as well as habitat and feeding habits.
Useless. Identified small black and gray bird as a cardinal. NO red in the picture. No picture in the app to compare to when it is identifying your picture. Another bird app to delete.
Review. To many adds
TOO MANY ADS!!!. There are way too many ads
Nope, doesn’t work. One of my chickens is apparently a duck and my rooster is a wild turkey.
Wow!. I am SO impressed with this app! I was in my house, and I saw a Robin on my lawn, so I scanned it, FROM INSIDE MY HOUSE! It works even when you scan birds 20ft away! Amazing!
Doesn’t work. It identified a house finch as a wild Turkey and many other wrong identifications. I’d like my money back but can’t figure out how.

Didn’t work. I normally don’t by these types of apps though I had to. I found a hurt bird and wanted to see if my local wildlife hospital would be able to help it. I took a picture of it and it said it was a type of duck. Turns out it was a robin.
Superb!. It makes me look sooo smart! There's a birdie...i click it...and Voila! I know the type of bird!
Oops. I gave it an illustration of a Spruce grouse, and it said it was a helmet at grouse close, but no cigar.
Birds. This app does not know it’s birds. Took picture of sparrows and it said Northern Cardinal twice.

Not for chicken breeds. I’m sure this works well for some birds that did not work well with identifying specific chicken breeds, I would even take a picture of a chicken and say great horned owl, kept trying to see if it would match, and it never did
No.. This app told me that my chicken was a cardinal.
It says my chicken is a woodpecker…. It says my chicken is a woodpecker…
Not working properly. As soon as I tap the record button it disappears. I’ve reinstalled twice and it does it still.

reviews.text: Bad!. Apparently my chickens are American robins and my papillon is a penguin. Clearly just going by color
This app is worthless!. Every attempt to identify a bird ends with ad. Don’t waste your time with this one.
Worst birding app ever.. The app just chooses a bird at random. I’m pretty sure AI wrote the app description or somebody very stupid. Don’t waste your time this app is a letdown.

Bad. I put up a very VERY clear photo of my pet cockatiel and then it called it a crow an owl and then the closest it got was a cockatoo but never ever got cockatiel! And he was even a albino cockatiel and so the crow makes no sense!!!
Does not identify the correct birds. I out a picture of a cockatiel and it said it was something else
an owl and a hawk?. Cannot tell the difference between an owl and a hawk!!!
Good. Would be better without ads, paid premium would be handy
To many ads. The app is good in its self but you get too many ads after every picture and then when trying to save it and then when you want to view it again

Useless. I have attended a falconry display and was able to get very close to the birds. I took photos of the birds. I took 3 photos of one bird and was presented with 3 different birds but not the right one. I did this for throughout the show and it didn’t get one right!!
Confidence good. Good like how it tells me the confidence it has in its answer. If it is not that positive I will try get a clearer photo! 😀👍
0 stars. A little egret was a great blue heron
Joke. These ppl are all bots i scanned a green parrot and it thought it was a “rock dove”. They’re all bots
Wow!. I’m so impressed, I’m raising a small bird but I don’t know it’s breed, thanks to this app I figured out that it’s a ‘house sparrow,
Amazing!. Although there aren’t many reviews, this app is VERY useful for identifying birds even the most blurry photos work very well… great app!
Hi. Make there be more features but for free
SO FAKE. I tried this on my brother's hand and it said it was a Robin and then I tried it on my rooster, and it said it was a turkey, vulture,
Five stars!. My family rescued an injured bird during a storm but we wanted to find out what kind she was! This app helped so much!

Wrong I’d. Tried twice with same bird and received two incorrect answers- my photo was a butcher bird but the ap described it as a shriek the first time and kingfisher the second time. Can’t trust the results
Great app but a few weird things. This app let me knows every bird’s name that i saw! The mistake is that my brother made a paper bird and the app think that is a real bird!!!
